scope: Candidate decomposition to falsify, not automatically accepted contract

dimensions.CUSTODY: Credential-bearing material or credential-bearing private object under one participant/generation custody becomes available to successor without new canonically authorized custody assignment; credential-bearing nature independently established.
dimensions.AUTHORITY: Successor can exercise prior participant/generation credential-derived authority without new valid authority binding. Secret copying not required; possession not sufficient; effective authority required.
dimensions.BINDING: Credential reference, descriptor or authority-bearing binding remains valid across subject/generation/process renewal when renewal/requalification required; binding continuity distinct from custody/effective authority.
